builds.name: Reference: Mixed tank
builds.goal: Reference for Zac: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A healing engage tank who enters from terrain, repeatedly disrupts nearby enemies and recovers through collected blobs. Count blobs collected and real knockup/contact time. AP/burn may raise damage but must repay lower defense; blobs out of reach cannot be granted as automatic healing. Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
testPlan: Kit question for Zac: Count blobs collected and real knockup/contact time. AP/burn may raise damage but must repay lower defense; blobs out of reach cannot be granted as automatic healing.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: None. Do not treat mana regeneration as None recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.

The route fails Zac's stated kit question: Count blobs collected and real knockup/contact time. AP/burn may raise damage but must repay lower defense; blobs out of reach cannot be granted as automatic healing.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.
Full cost 15,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: None. Do not treat mana regeneration as None recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zac bounces [4] times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals [120 / 190 / 260 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage. Subsequent bounces deal [(120 / 190 / 260 + (0.4) × AP) × (0.5)] magic damage and Slow by [20]% for [1] second.

Zac gains up to [50]% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing.

Zac's body erupts, dealing [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80] + [(4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage to nearby enemies.

Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.

Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.3) × AP + (0.03) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow. 

If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.3) × AP + (0.03) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage and are briefly Slowed.

Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over [0.9 / 1 / 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3] seconds.

Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to [(0.5) × (2)] second (based on charge time), dealing them [60 / 105 / 150 / 195 / 240 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit.

Each time Zac hits an enemy with an Ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore [characterLevelInterpolation(0.04 → 0.08; raw flags preserved)] Max Health.

Upon dying, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain after [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=8, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 17, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds, he will revive with 10-50% Health based on the surviving bloblet's Health. This has a [300] second Cooldown.
